summary: Female skier skied out of the Buttermilk Resort boundary en route to the Sugar Bowl when her gear failed, leaving her 'cold, weak, tired, and unable to move'; she called 911 around 5pm Monday. Pitkin County Sheriff rescue personnel reached her via the western backcountry access gate, gave her food and water, and transported her back to the ski area where an ambulance waited; paramedics administered treatment.
location: Sugar Bowl backcountry near Buttermilk Resort
notes: Run 843 Chunk B (Unofficial Networks). Article published 2016-01-12 reporting 'Monday evening' = 2016-01-11 (Monday-verified).
